text:
```yaml
name: Playwright E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - dev
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - dev

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Copy built files to js-dist
        run: cp -r dist/* js-dist/

      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: npm run test:e2e -- --timeout=60000

      - name: Upload test report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report.html

      - name: Upload screenshots
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: screenshots
          path: screenshots/
```
